texts.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]满意地报告称，对[Root.GetName]的环境改造已经完成！利用从最后的巴奥躯体里回收的精挑细选的巴奥基因片段，我们成功在实验室中制造出了杂种植物并在部署这些植物仅仅五年后就成功完成了对[Root.GetName]气候和大气层的环境改造。

与预期一样，这些杂种植物在行星上到处增殖，目前正进入一种“休眠”期，因为[Root.GetName]大气层化学成分的改变使它们不再活跃。

令人难以置信的是，管理部门报告称在这一过程里产生了意料之外的结果：[Root.GetName]上出现了许多智慧外星生命！它们与古代的巴奥高度相似，但其拥有广泛混合的此行星自然植被的遗传物质。

尽管不是蜂巢思维的一分子，这些新巴奥外星人似乎同它们的祖先一样平和。无论如何，我们必须妥善解决它们在[Root.GetName]上存在一事。
texts.en:
Our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] are pleased to report that the terraforming process on [Root.GetName] has completed! The deployment of new laboratory-created plant hybrids, made using carefully selected segments of the Baol genetic code as harvested from the body of the last Baol, successfully transformed [Root.GetName]'s over a mere five-year period.

The hybrid plants multiplied across the structure as expected, and are now entering a 'dormant' phase, as the chemical atmospheric changes on [Root.GetName] have now deactivated them.

 Incredibly, our administration reports an unexpected outcome of the process: a number of sapient aliens, incredibly similar to the ancient Baol, but possessing a vast mixture of genetic material from our own vegetal resources, have appeared on [Root.GetName]!

While not members of a Hive Mind, these Nu-Baol aliens seem as peaceful as their ancestors. One way or another, we shall have to address their presence on [Root.GetName].

Our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] are pleased to report that the terraforming process on [Root.GetName] has completed! The deployment of new laboratory-created plant hybrids, made using carefully selected segments of the Baol genetic code as harvested from the body of the last Baol, successfully transformed [Root.GetName]'s over a mere five-year period.

The hybrid plants multiplied across the structure as expected, and are now entering a 'dormant' phase, as the chemical atmospheric changes on [Root.GetName] have now deactivated them.

 Incredibly, our administration reports an unexpected outcome of the process: a number of sapient aliens, incredibly similar to the ancient Baol, but possessing a vast mixture of genetic material from our own vegetal resources, have appeared on [Root.GetName]!

Although initially part of a different Hive Mind these Nu-Baol aliens could easily be integrated into our consciousness. One way or another, we shall have to address their presence on [Root.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们的[Owner.GetTerraformerPlural]满意地报告称，我们对[Root.GetName]的环境改造已经完成！这一体系的生命支持系统已升级完成，这要归功于我们部署了实验室制造出的杂交植物，其中包含精心挑选的巴奥遗传密码的片段。

又一次，这一尚未被我们的基因学家所理解的过程又导致了一定数量的巴奥人口出现。
texts.en:
Our [Owner.GetTerraformerPlural] are pleased to report that the terraforming process on [Root.GetName] has completed! The structure's life support has been successfully upgraded, owing to our deployment of laboratory-created plant hybrids, containing carefully selected segments of the Baol genetic code.

Once again, as a result of the process - itself not quite fully understood by our geneticists - a number of Nu-Baol populations have appeared.
